channel.title: Physical Intelligence Blog
channel.description: Latest blog posts and research from Physical Intelligence

item.title: π0: Our First Generalist Policy
item.description: Our first generalist policy, π0, a prototype model that combines large-scale multi-task and multi-robot data collection with a new network architecture to enable the most capable and dexterous generalist robot policy to date.

item.title: Open Sourcing π0
item.description: We are releasing the weights and code for π0 as well as our new π0-FAST autoregressive model.

item.title: π0.5: a VLA with Open-World Generalization
item.description: Our latest generalist policy, π0.5, extends π0 and enables open-world generalization. Our new model can control a mobile manipulator to clean up an entirely new kitchen or bedroom.

item.title: π0.6*: a VLA that Learns from Experience
item.description: A method for training our generalist policies with RL to improve success rate and throughput on real-world tasks.

item.title: Moravec's Paradox and the Robot Olympics
item.description: By fine-tuning our latest model, we were able to solve a series of very difficult manipulation challenge tasks.

item.title: The Physical Intelligence Layer
item.description: General-purpose physical intelligence models will enable a Cambrian explosion of robotics applications. See how our partners are already solving real-world problems.

item.title: π0.7: a Steerable Model with Emergent Capabilities
item.description: A steerable robotic foundation model that exhibits a step-change in generalization.
